classification.difficultyReason: Requires region sketches, identification of bounds, expansion of squared radii and symmetry for two bounded regions.

content.prompt: Find the volume of the solid formed by rotating the region with the given boundaries about the $x$-axis. (A sketch of each region will be needed.)

spec.description: Authored region sketch showing the line and the bounded area from x=3 to x=5.
Authored region sketch showing the square-root curve and vertical boundaries.
Authored sketch of the bounded region beneath the parabola between its two zeros.

answer.worked:
The zeros are $x=-1,0,1$. Both bounded regions are included. Since $(x^3-x)^2$ is even, integrate over $[0,1]$ and double.
$$\begin{aligned}V&=2\pi\int_0^1(x^3-x)^2\,dx\\V&=2\pi\int_0^1(x^6-2x^4+x^2)\,dx\\V&=2\pi\left[\frac{x^7}{7}-\frac{2x^5}{5}+\frac{x^3}{3}\right]_0^1\\V&=2\pi\left(\frac17-\frac25+\frac13\right)\\V&=\frac{16\pi}{105}\text{ units}^3\end{aligned}$$
